notes: Top-1/acceptable agreement is measured against teacher labels (agent annotations and benchmark-selected targets, reported separately by source), not privacy or utility outcomes of the learned selector's plans.
135 of 2445 training examples come from weak (unreviewed or disputed) labels; weights: agreement/approved 1.0, unreviewed 0.6, disagreement 0.3, shared across goal variants.
Test = held-out customer_service domain: never used for training, early stopping or temperature fitting.
Preference is the model's ranking among valid candidates, not a probability of anonymity.
Goal paraphrase variants of one scenario are not independent examples; per-label counts are reported as 'labels'.
